sn24.8:1.1: _Mahā_ in the title refers to the long explanation of the view, not to its “greatness”.
sn24.8:1.15: The reading here (“the foolish and the astute roll away unraveling to pleasure and pain”) is corrupted from the previous line, and I adopt the reading as found in [dn2:20.11]() and [mn76:16.15]().
